speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing the decreased vision and black spots in your right eye? Is the vision loss sudden or gradual, and are you experiencing any eye pain or redness?

speaker: Patient
text: 34-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of decreased vision and seeing black spots in the right eye. He reports no pain, and the left eye is asymptomatic. He mentions being treated for fungal esophagitis 6 months ago and was diagnosed with Kaposi's sarcoma 2 years ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of AIDS and prior opportunistic infections, I need to know your current CD4 count and HIV viral load. Are you currently adherent to your antiretroviral therapy, and have you noticed any floaters or flashes of light in the affected eye?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Decreased vision and black spots in the right eye. I also have No pain, Left eye is asymptomatic.
